# Celestial Object Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:CelestialObjectType`](gmeow-CelestialObjectType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CelestialObjectType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

The kind of an astronomical object (star, galaxy, nebula, planet, asteroid, spacecraft, etc.). A value, not a [`CelestialLocation`](gmeow-CelestialLocation.md) subclass: the set is open-ended (IVOA object-type vocabulary lists ~100 types) and they share the same structure.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:CelestialObjectType`](gmeow-CelestialObjectType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
